description: Visual spreadsheet editor for Warcraft III map .slk files, with multilingual UI and multi-row/column selection.
config.language.description: UI language. "auto" follows VS Code's display language; "zh" forces the Chinese UI, "en" forces English.
config.focusOnOpen.description: Move keyboard focus into the spreadsheet when an SLK editor is opened. This prevents Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V from being handled by the Explorer (which would copy the .slk file itself). Disable it if you prefer to keep browsing files with the keyboard after opening one.
